product.name: DeepJudge Knowledge Search
product.description: An AI-powered enterprise search system for legal teams that indexes internal documents and data across multiple repositories, enabling concept-based, permission-aware retrieval of relevant firm knowledge.

product.name: DeepJudge AI Workflows
product.description: A platform for building and governing AI agents and automated workflows that use a law firm’s internal data to perform multi-step legal tasks and generate work product.
